confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, listings or booking pages. 2026 levels are extrapolated with an allowance for recent inflation. Cafe and restaurant anchors are moderately well known; hostel and hotel anchors are least certain because July peak-season rates vary widely. Cocktail was set at roughly 2.5 times the draft beer and the wine glass near the beer price, because direct Vienna knowledge for those is weaker. USD values convert euro-denominated estimates at an assumed rate, not a live quote. The FX value came from RBA search results rather than a direct page read; RBA homepage copies showed the 15 Oct figure, so the live table should be re-checked.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city's prices were copied. Regional basis: large Western and Central European capitals with similar summer tourism demand, using Prague and Budapest as lower reference points and Munich as a higher one.
